source.author: umami_restaurants
source.text:
Spooky vibes have officially taken over 📍UMAMI Ku’damm. 👻🎃

A little reminder that our October specials are still here to make your spooky season even sweeter. 🍂

🥃 KÜRBICILLIN — Pumpkin-infused blended whisky, ginger, pumpkin spice, lime juice & Angostura bitters.

🥭 PUMP IT UP — Creamy pumpkin smoothie with fresh mango, cherry nectar, ginger & coconut milk.

🍫 CHOCOLATE DREAM — Freshly baked chocolate brownie with almonds, walnuts & fresh fruit.

✨ GOLDEN LUCK — Mango-passion fruit mousse cake with soft sponge layers & fresh fruit.

Come for the spooky vibes, stay for the treats. 🖤

Only until the end of October. See you at UMAMI Ku’damm!

#UmamiBerlin #UmamiKudamm #HalloweenAtUmami #BerlinFoodie

reference.notes: Venue's own promotional post. The hard calls were whether the limited-time seasonal specials are new items or a deal, since they have dates but no discount, and whether the Halloween theme counts as an event or simply as atmosphere.

match.note: The tagged location and the text both name UMAMI Ku'damm, which matches the single-branch Umami Ku'damm on Rankestraße near the Kurfürstendamm.
